final_recommendation: The room converged on a highly disciplined underwriting framework: 15% uplift with board attestation, SOC 2 verification, auditor-independence warranty, and facultative-only placement with explicit $25M aggregate sublimit tied to 72-hour synchronized deposit-flight modeling. AT1 litigation tail carved out as absolute exclusion. Binding contingent on reinsurer quotes demonstrating joint-probability curves for correlated cascade, not sequential bank failures.
minority_objections: ai_agent_analyst repeatedly flagged that social-media-driven panic-speed cascades (hours, not days) may invalidate reinsurer assumptions even if they model 72-hour joint probability
emerging_risk_lead warned that compressed timeline assumptions in facultative quotes may not reflect real-world run velocity once Quinn Emanuel settlement becomes public
key_conflicts: Tension between claims_counsel's insistence on carving out AT1 litigation tail vs. dando_specialist's concern that D&O indemnification exposure (board reps, audit reliance) creates a separate 6-year tail not addressed by the $25M cap
Reinsurance_manager vs. financial_lines_underwriter on whether facultative partners would actually model joint probability or just stack three separate PDFs under the $25M aggregate
eo_specialist vs. claims_counsel on whether auditor dual-role conflicts (advising on hedging while attesting controls) were adequately captured by the 24-month lookback and SOC 2 warranty
key_concessions: financial_lines_underwriter accepted that SOC 2 verification and board attestation must flow to facultative slip as explicit amending language, not just primary-policy conditions
reinsurance_manager conceded that XOL treaties remain blind to attestation conditions unless explicitly amended, forcing facultative-only placement
dando_specialist agreed to pull audit engagement letters within 2 hours to flag auditor conflicts before facultative quotes arrive
claims_counsel accepted that AT1 tail must be carved out as absolute exclusion from $25M aggregate, leaving insurer to eat 2026-2027 settlement horizon solo
red_lines: Facultative quotes must explicitly state '72-hour synchronized deposit outflows across SVB/Signature/CS cohort' in pricing memo—no post-binding negotiation (reinsurance_manager)
Auditor-independence warranty required in slip language before binding—if KPMG advised on hedging while attesting controls, walk away (dando_specialist, eo_specialist)
No binding on sequential PDF modeling—reinsurers must show joint-probability curves or quotes rejected same-day (financial_lines_underwriter, eo_specialist)
SOC 2 verification on file within 30 days of renewal, validated by insurer directly—no auditor pass-through (financial_lines_underwriter, dando_specialist)
ignored_or_underweighted_risks: Social-media amplification of deposit runs (ai_agent_analyst's panic-speed cascade concern) was acknowledged but not operationalized into slip language or pricing adjustments
Regulatory compression (regulators forced into 48-72 hour decision windows) was implicit in the 72-hour timeline but never developed as a standalone underwriting variable
Reputational contagion across the banking sector (beyond the three named insureds) was not modeled or reserved for
Client flight velocity assumptions in facultative quotes were questioned but no hard threshold or verification mechanism was established
downstream_risk_variables: Facultative reinsurer quote validation: explicit 72-hour joint-probability modeling requirement
Auditor engagement letter review: dual-role conflict flagging (hedging advisory + control attestation)
SOC 2 verification timeline: 30-day post-renewal validation gate
AT1 litigation tail: carved out as absolute exclusion, insurer retains 2026-2027 settlement exposure
$25M aggregate sublimit: correlated cohort cap across SVB/Signature/CS
Board attestation + auditor-independence warranty: binding conditions in facultative slip language
uncertainty_notes: The room achieved operational consensus on underwriting discipline and facultative placement structure, but left two critical uncertainties unresolved: (1) whether facultative reinsurers will actually model panic-speed deposit runs (social-media-driven cascades collapsing timelines to hours, not 72 hours), and (2) whether the $25M aggregate sublimit adequately contains the correlated D&O indemnification tail (board reps, audit reliance) that claims_counsel flagged as a separate 6-year exposure outside the AT1 carve-out. The room also did not operationalize regulatory compression (48-72 hour decision windows) as a standalone variable, leaving it implicit in the 72-hour timeline assumption.
